visit_notes.note: S: Heart failure follow-up. Patient reports feeling well. Denies dyspnea at rest. Reports walking to mailbox without significant shortness of breath. Denies orthopnea. Weight has been stable per her report. O: BP 118/72. HR 76 irregular (Afib). JVD absent. Lungs clear. No peripheral edema noted on exam. Weight 71.2 kg (baseline). A: HFrEF - clinically compensated. Afib rate controlled. P: Continue current medications. Daily weight monitoring via RPM - alert if weight increases more than 2 kg above dry weight of 71.2 kg within 3 days. Follow up in 6 weeks.

S: Acute decompensated heart failure. Patient presented with 4 kg weight gain over 5 days, worsening dyspnea, bilateral ankle swelling. Had stopped furosemide 2 weeks ago thinking she was doing well. O: BP 142/88. HR 88 irregular. Bibasilar crackles. 2+ pitting edema bilateral ankles. Weight 75.5 kg. A: ADHF, likely precipitated by diuretic non-compliance. P: IV furosemide, resume oral regimen. Patient counseled extensively on daily weights and medication importance.
